x.description: ndarray Input NumPy array to cast. ``array_likes`` are explicitly not supported here.

dtype.description: dtype Data type of the result.

copy.description: bool, optional Specifies whether to copy an array when the specified dtype matches the data type of the input array ``x``. If ``True``, a newly allocated array must always be returned. If ``False`` and the specified dtype matches the data type of the input array, the input array must be returned; otherwise, a newly allocated array must be returned. Defaults to ``True``.

device.description: str, optional The device on which to place the returned array. Default: None. For Array-API interoperability only, so must be ``"cpu"`` if passed.

output.description: ------- ndarray An array having the specified data type.
